contexts.text: That the workman made it () = that it is from proprium. AE 279:9.
The work of the workman... () = that it is from Own intelligence. AR 450.
They say that everyone is the artificer of his own fortune. SE 4988:end.
He showed me four smiths () = the like things as iron, namely, truth in ultimates, which is mighty and potent...
As these falsities and evils are from man's Own intelligence, they are called the work of the workman, and of the hands of the goldsmith ().

Moreover, the work of the workman, of the artificer, and of the mechanic, in the Word, = whatever of doctrine, of religion, and of worship is from man's Own intelligence. This is why the altar and temple were built, by command, of whole stones, and were not hewn by any workman, or artificer. Illustrated, Explained.
